features.name: Oath Spells & Tenets
features.description:
**Oath of the Hearth Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3rd | burning hands, sanctuary |
| 5th | calm emotions, flame blade |
| 9th | protection from energy, tiny hut |
| 13th | guardian of faith, wall of fire |
| 17th | flame strike, hallow |

**Tenets:** Bastion of Peace — Reach out the hand of friendship. Beacon in the Dark — Shine welcoming light. Hospitality of Home — Provide comforts to peaceful strangers. Protection from the Elements — Ensure shelter from weather. Repel the Cold — Strive against unnatural winter.

features.name: Divine Sense
features.description: In addition to celestials, fiends, and undead, your Divine Sense also detects any cold creature within 60 ft that is not behind total cover.

features.name: Fiery Smite
features.description: When you use Divine Smite, you can choose for the extra damage to be fire or radiant. The extra damage increases to 1d8 only if the target is an undead or a cold creature.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain two Channel Divinity options:

**Cease Hostility.** As an action, speak soothing words. For 1 minute, each creature within 60 ft that can see or hear you must succeed on a CHA save to attack another creature (hostile creatures have disadvantage). Ends on a creature if it is attacked or harmed by a spell.

**Turn Boreal Creatures.** As an action, speak a prayer against unnatural cold. Each cold creature within 30 ft that can see or hear you must make a WIS save or be turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

features.name: Aura of the Hearth
features.description: Beginning at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 ft have advantage on saves against spells and effects dealing cold damage. On a successful save vs cold that would normally deal half damage, they instead take no damage. Also advantage on saves vs the long-term effects of cold weather exposure. At 18th level, range increases to 30 ft.

features.name: Icewalker
features.description: Starting at 15th level, you have resistance to cold damage. You can't be restrained or petrified by cold or ice. You can move across and climb icy surfaces without ability checks, and difficult terrain of ice or snow doesn't cost you extra movement.

features.name: Roaring Fire
features.description:
At 20th level, for 1 minute you gain:

* Bright light 20-ft radius, dim light 20 ft further.
* Cold creatures within 20 ft take 2d8 fire damage at the start of their turn (ignores resistance/immunity).
* Paladin fire spells with 1-action cast time can be cast as a bonus action.
* Weapon attacks deal extra 1d6 fire damage. If the target is a cold creature, it must make a WIS save or be frightened of you for 1 minute (or until it takes damage).

1/long rest.

payload.name: Roaring Fire
payload.description: For 1 min: 20-ft bright light; cold creatures take 2d8 fire at turn start; fire spells as bonus actions; weapon attacks +1d6 fire (cold creatures: WIS save or frightened).
